description: Breaks organic search performance down by country and device, from live Google Search Console data in your Coupler.io workspace — clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position by market and by phone/desktop/tablet, against the site's own average. Use for "how does my organic search do by country", "which markets underperform in search", "is mobile or desktop better for my search traffic", "where am I losing search clicks by device", "should I localise for SEO", "which countries rank worse than my site average" — even when the user never says "country" or "device". This is the where-and-on-what view: which markets and devices earn their impressions and which lag the site. For query-level opportunities use gsc-search-opportunity-finder; for what traffic does after landing use gsc-ga4-landing-page-performance. Google Search Console only.
